description: Get structured financial history for one CVR (read-only).

cvrnummer.description: Danish CVR number, exactly 8 digits as a string, e.g. "24256790" (Novo Nordisk A/S). Get it from search_companies or recommend_leads.

limit.description: Maximum number of annual statements to return, newest first (1 to 50), e.g. 5. Default 10.

year.description: Only return the fiscal year whose period ends in this calendar year, e.g. 2024.

name: get_financials
title: Get company financials
